SELECT m.MATERIAL_CODE, m.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.STRUCTURE_NAME, MAX(IF(C.ID IS NULL, '02', '01')) STRUCTURE_TYPE, MAX(IFNULL(i.PRODUCT_STATUS, IFNULL(r.PRODUCT_STATUS, CASE WHEN REF.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = '03' THEN 'S' WHEN REF.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = '02' THEN 'T' WHEN REF.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = '01' THEN 'X' ELSE null END ))) PRODUCT_STATUS, m.EMBRYO_CODE, m.EMBRYO_DESC MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, MAX(IFNULL(i.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, IFNULL(r.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, REF.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE))) CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, m.BRAND, m.SPECIFICATIONS, m.MAIN_PATTERN, m.PATTERN, m.PRO_SIZE, m.SINGLE_TIRE_WEIGHT, m.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, m.SECTION_WIDTH, r.MOULD_CAVITY_QTY, r.TYPE_BLOCK_QTY, max( d.AVERAGE_SALE_QTY ) AVERAGE_SALE_QTY, if(max(d.AVERAGE_SALE_QTY) > 0, round(max(d.STOCK_QTY) / max(d.AVERAGE_SALE_QTY), 1), 0) INVENTORY_SALES_RATIO, max( IFNULL(r.DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, CASE WHEN IFNULL(FP.PARAM_VALUE, FP.DEFAULE_VALUE) = 'M' THEN lc.MES_CAPACITY / 2 WHEN IFNULL(FP.PARAM_VALUE, FP.DEFAULE_VALUE) = 'A' THEN lc.APS_CAPACITY / 2 ELSE lc.STANDARD_CAPACITY / 2 END) ) DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, sum( ifnull(d.ORI_HEIGHT_QTY, d.HEIGHT_QTY) ) HEIGHT_QTY, sum( ifnull(d.ORI_MID_QTY, d.MID_QTY) ) MID_QTY, sum( d.CYCLE_RESERVE_QTY ) CYCLE_RESERVE_QTY, sum( d.POSTPONE_QTY ) POSTPONE_QTY, sum( case when d.IS_SCHEDULE = '1' then d.CONVENTION_RESERVE_QTY else 0 end) CONVENTION_RESERVE_QTY, mc.NET_QTY UN_RESTRICTED_NET_QTY, r.TOTAL_QTY, r.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.BEGIN_DAY, r.END_DAY, r.DAY_1, r.DAY_2, r.DAY_3, r.DAY_4, r.DAY_5, r.DAY_6, r.DAY_7, r.DAY_8, r.DAY_9, r.DAY_10, r.DAY_11, r.DAY_12, r.DAY_13, r.DAY_14, r.DAY_15, r.DAY_16, r.DAY_17, r.DAY_18, r.DAY_19, r.DAY_20, r.DAY_21, r.DAY_22, r.DAY_23, r.DAY_24, r.DAY_25, r.DAY_26, r.DAY_27, r.DAY_28, r.DAY_29, r.DAY_30, r.DAY_31, F.DAY_27 LAST_27, F.DAY_28 LAST_28, F.DAY_29 LAST_29, F.DAY_30 LAST_30, F.DAY_31 LAST_31,
r.ADJUST_QTY1, r.ADJUST_QTY2, r.ADJUST_QTY3, r.ADJUST_QTY4, r.ORIGINAL_TOTAL_QTY, ifnull(r.total_qty, 0) - ifnull(pm.PRODUCTION_QTY,0) PRODUCT_SURPLUS,
F.PRODUCTION_VERSION LAST_PRODUCTION_VERSION, '1' DATA_TYPE, '2' LOCATION_TYPE /*内外销，目前没有地方取，暂时固定外销*/ FROM T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO m INNER JOIN ( SELECT STRUCTURE_NAME, MAX( PRO_SIZE ) MIN_PRO_SIZE FROM T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO M WHERE M.FACTORY_CODE = '116' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY STRUCTURE_NAME ) MM ON MM.STRUCTURE_NAME = M.STRUCTURE_NAME LEFT JOIN T_DP_DEMAND_PLAN d ON d.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{dayResult.monthPlanVersion} AND d.FACTORY_CODE = m.FACTORY_CODE AND d.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE AND d.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MP_MOLD_CAPACITY_LOG mc ON mc.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mc.FACTORY_CODE = m.FACTORY_CODE AND mc.production_version = #{dayResult.productionVersion} AND mc.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_MP_PROC_MONTH_PLAN_INIT i on i.MONTH_PLAN_ID = d.id AND m.FACTORY_CODE = i.FACTORY_CODE AND i.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{dayResult.productionVersion} AND i.IS_DELETE = 0
LEFT JOIN T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL r ON m.MATERIAL_CODE = r.MATERIAL_CODE
LEFT JOIN T_MP_MOULDING_DAY_RESULT r ON m.MATERIAL_CODE = r.MATERIAL_CODE
AND m.FACTORY_CODE = r.FACTORY_CODE AND r.production_version = #{dayResult.productionVersion} AND r.IS_DELETE = 0
LEFT JOIN T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_MONITOR pm ON m.MATERIAL_CODE = pm.MATERIAL_CODE AND m.FACTORY_CODE = pm.FACTORY_CODE AND r.PRODUCTION_VERSION = pm.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND pm.IS_DELETE = 0
LEFT JOIN T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f ON f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE AND f.`YEAR_MONTH` = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(concat(#{dayResult.year},'-',#{dayResult.month},'-1'),INTERVAL 1 month), '%Y%m') LEFT JOIN T_DP_CYCLE_STRUCT_CONFIG C ON C.STRUCTURE_NAME = M.STRUCTURE_NAME AND C.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MDM_SKU_LH_CAPACITY lc ON lc.IS_DELETE = 0 AND lc.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_MP_FACTORY_PARAM FP ON FP.IS_DELETE = 0 AND PARAM_CODE = 'SYS0202002' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MAX(CASE WHEN t.TRIAL_STATUS = 'S' THEN '03' WHEN t.TRIAL_STATUS = 'T' THEN '02' WHEN t.TRIAL_STATUS = 'X' THEN '01' ELSE '00' END ) CONSTRUCTION_STAGE FROM t_mdm_sku_construction_ref t WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY material_code ) REF ON REF.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE m.FACTORY_CODE = #{dayResult.factoryCode} AND m.IS_DELETE = 0 AND m.STRUCTURE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (QUALITY_STATE_CODE != '2' or d.FACTORY_CODE = m.FACTORY_CODE)
AND d.FACTORY_CODE = m.FACTORY_CODE
AND m.STRUCTURE_NAME = #{dayResult.structureName}
GROUP BY MM.MIN_PRO_SIZE, m.MATERIAL_CODE, m.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.STRUCTURE_NAME, d.STRUCTURE_TYPE, m.EMBRYO_CODE, m.EMBRYO_DESC, m.BRAND, m.SPECIFICATIONS, m.MAIN_PATTERN, m.PATTERN, m.PRO_SIZE, m.SINGLE_TIRE_WEIGHT, m.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, m.SECTION_WIDTH, mc.NET_QTY, r.MOULD_CAVITY_QTY, r.TYPE_BLOCK_QTY, r.TOTAL_QTY, r.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.TOTAL_QTY, r.BEGIN_DAY, r.END_DAY, r.DAY_1, r.DAY_2, r.DAY_3, r.DAY_4, r.DAY_5, r.DAY_6, r.DAY_7, r.DAY_8, r.DAY_9, r.DAY_10, r.DAY_11, r.DAY_12, r.DAY_13, r.DAY_14, r.DAY_15, r.DAY_16, r.DAY_17, r.DAY_18, r.DAY_19, r.DAY_20, r.DAY_21, r.DAY_22, r.DAY_23, r.DAY_24, r.DAY_25, r.DAY_26, r.DAY_27, r.DAY_28, r.DAY_29, r.DAY_30, r.DAY_31, F.YEAR , F.MONTH , F.DAY_27 , F.DAY_28 , F.DAY_29 , F.DAY_30 , F.DAY_31 ,
r.ADJUST_QTY1, r.ADJUST_QTY2, r.ADJUST_QTY3, r.ADJUST_QTY4, r.ORIGINAL_TOTAL_QTY, pm.PRODUCTION_QTY,
F.PRODUCTION_VERSION ORDER BY MM.MIN_PRO_SIZE, SPECIFICATIONS, STRUCTURE_NAME, PRO_SIZE, SECTION_WIDTH, MOULD_CAVITY_QTY DESC, TYPE_BLOCK_QTY DESC, MAIN_PATTERN
